title: pending_source_stub → cancelled_orphan (driven by upstream reservation.cleanup event)

preconditions.comment: Anchor-based TTL evidence is validated upstream by the reservation.cleanup reducer (see §15.4.26). The downstream transition cites that cleanup event via evidence_refs; ttl_evidence is NOT in transition payload (see event-payload.schema.json:1354).

expected_outcome.design_note: Separation of concerns: reservation.cleanup carries Anchor-based ttl_evidence (§6.4 + cleanup payload schema); transition payload only links to the cleanup event via evidence_refs. This keeps each event kind's payload narrowly scoped and lets the reducer verify TTL once at the cleanup reducer, not on every downstream transition.
